title: The Board's statutory rehabilitation program and its fulfilment by adopting the department's program
rule_summary: M.G.L. c. 112, § 24H(a) provides that the board of registration in pharmacy shall establish a rehabilitation program for registered pharmacists, pharmacy interns and pharmacy technicians who have a substance use issue, and § 24H(b)(i) provides that the rehabilitation program shall serve as a voluntary alternative to traditional disciplinary actions. M.G.L. c. 112, § 65G(b)(2) provides that a board of registration that is required to establish a similar rehabilitation program by another requirement of chapter 112 shall fulfill that requirement by formally adopting the program established by the department of public health under § 65G(b)(1) in lieu of establishing its own.
exam_relevance: Tests what became of the pharmacy-specific rehabilitation program: the Board's duty stated in § 24H is to be fulfilled by formally adopting the department's program rather than by establishing a separate one.
common_confusions: Section 24H remains in chapter 112; § 65G(b)(2) directs how a board with such a duty fulfils it, by formally adopting the department's program in lieu of establishing its own.
Section 24H describes the pharmacy rehabilitation program as a voluntary alternative to traditional disciplinary actions.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the current text of M.G.L. c. 112, §§ 24H and 65G on malegislature.gov.
